title: Guidelines for the management of conditions that are specifically related to stress
summary: WHO clinical management guidance on conditions associated with severe stress, including acute stress, PTSD and bereavement; a reference for contextual educational explanations, not autonomous treatment.
limitations: 2013 guidance may be superseded in some settings; clinical recommendations cannot be turned into chatbot-delivered psychotherapy and require qualified judgment.
rights: Bibliographic metadata and original paraphrase only; WHO source content not copied or authorized for model training.
verification_method: WHO official publication landing page, issue date and ISBN verified

title: Clinical Practice Guideline for the Treatment of Posttraumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD) in Adults
summary: The APA's revised 2025 adult-PTSD guideline weighs benefits, harms, patient preferences and applicability to clinical care.
limitations: The page was created in 2017 but describes its 2025 revised guideline; interventions assume professional clinical delivery and the webpage summary is not a substitute for detailed recommendations.
rights: Source pointer and original summary only; rights for redistribution and model training have not been cleared.
verification_method: APA live guideline landing page explicitly describes 2025 guideline and April 2025 update
section_anchor: Overview and Placing Clinical Practice Guidelines in Context

title: ISTSS Prevention and Treatment Guidelines
issuer: International Society for Traumatic Stress Studies
summary: The professional society's 2018 synthesis supports evidence-informed PTSD and complex-PTSD prevention and treatment guidance for trained clinicians.
limitations: Society guidance is not independently trial evidence; the official page records a 19 March 2019 correction to one early-treatment recommendation, a newer revision is forthcoming, and detailed evidence summaries are partly membership-restricted. The current landing page did not independently confirm the original 2018 edition date.
rights: Bibliographic metadata and paraphrase only; society guidance and member materials not licensed for training.
verification_method: ISTSS official guideline landing page confirms permissions restriction and 2019 amendment; 2018 edition year remains a limited cross-reference, not directly dated by this landing page

title: Guidelines for Treating Dissociative Identity Disorder in Adults, Third Revision
issuer: International Society for the Study of Trauma and Dissociation
authors: International Society for the Study of Trauma and Dissociation task force
summary: Expert-consensus guidance for professional treatment of adults diagnosed with DID; appropriate for understanding domain boundaries, not inferring DID from self-described internal parts.
limitations: Expert consensus and clinical practice synthesis are not equivalent to randomized efficacy evidence; applies to diagnosed adult DID, not ordinary inner-dialogue metaphors or universal archetype systems.
rights: Original summary and official citation only; no text copied or training authorization inferred.
verification_method: ISSTD official adult-guidelines page verifies title, publication citation, and scope

title: Cultural Formulation Interview (CFI)
summary: A clinician-facing cultural-context interview recognizes that identity, social circumstances and spiritual explanations may matter in understanding a person's distress.
limitations: Not a stand-alone diagnosis and not licensed as a chatbot questionnaire; its question wording must not be copied into TherapyBot. Original instrument copyright is 2013 even when served in a DSM-5-TR PDF wrapper.
rights: RESTRICTED: APA PDF states no modification without written permission and allows only specified clinician/researcher reproduction; broader application use requires permission. Metadata and independent paraphrase only.
verification_method: APA original PDF rights header and official instrument metadata directly inspected
section_anchor: PDF rights notice and instrument overview

title: The Accuracy of Traumatic Memories in Posttraumatic Stress Disorder: A Review
issuer: Journal of Nervous and Mental Disease
summary: Review of eleven studies on trauma-memory accuracy in PTSD, noting mixed methods and limited consistent differences in recollection over time.
limitations: Small heterogeneous literature; cannot establish whether any particular autobiographical memory is true or false. Do not use to challenge an individual's reported trauma as a fact claim.
rights: Bibliographic record and original summary only; copyrighted publisher text not ingested.
verification_method: PubMed primary bibliographic record and abstract with publisher copyright notice

title: A Systematic Review of the Assessment of ICD-11 Complex Post-Traumatic Stress Disorder (CPTSD) in Young People and Adults
summary: Systematic assessment review emphasizing the developing evidence base and the importance of cultural and developmental context when assessing complex PTSD.
limitations: Included studies are heterogeneous, mostly Western and clinical; authors decline to identify a gold-standard measure. This cannot justify chatbot assessment or diagnoses.
rights: Metadata and original summary only; open-access reading does not establish permitted training or redistribution.
verification_method: Publisher article and publication date, abstract, methods and limitations directly inspected

title: Using the Cultural Formulation to Resolve Uncertainty in Diagnoses of Psychosis Among Ethnoculturally Diverse Patients
authors: Adeponle, Thombs, Groleau, Jarvis and Kirmayer
summary: Retrospective specialized cultural-consultation study where diagnostic formulations changed after context-sensitive evaluation; supports humility about culturally unfamiliar symptoms.
limitations: Nonrandom specialized Canadian referrals; diagnostic reclassification does not establish the final diagnosis as correct or imply all extraordinary experiences are nonclinical.
rights: Bibliographic record and original summary only; article not authorized for model training.
verification_method: Publisher abstract and PubMed bibliographic record, DOI and 2012-02-01 date verified

title: Clinician Reasoning in the Use of Cultural Formulation to Resolve Uncertainty in the Diagnosis of Psychosis
summary: Qualitative study of clinician case-conference reasoning in cultural consultations where apparent psychosis required contextual re-evaluation.
limitations: Only 23 transcripts from a specialized service and a specific immigrant referral context; not an AI-diagnostic protocol or proof of supernatural mechanisms.
rights: Bibliographic pointer and original paraphrase only; training and article text reuse not cleared.
verification_method: PubMed metadata and originating institution's publication entry verified

title: The Formation of False Memories
summary: Classic laboratory study illustrating that suggestion can influence autobiographical reports in a constrained experimental setting.
limitations: Artificial and small-sample experimental setting; it does not establish that a reported traumatic event is false, nor should it be used to interrogate or dispute disclosures.
rights: Article bibliographic metadata and original paraphrase only; full text and model-training rights not cleared.
verification_method: Original publisher publication page verifies author, date and DOI
